alerts.description: Saturday westerly near gale force 7. Occasionally strong gale force 9 in the northern parts, decreasing saturday afternoon.
alerts.instruction: Consider not taking the boat out: Risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.

alerts.title: Ice, yellow level, Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway, 2026-11-06T15:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T10:00:00+00:00
alerts.area: Lowland areas and valleys in southeastern Norway
alerts.description: There is risk of glaze ice, due to widespread freezing fog and occasional freezing drizzle. The fog and drizzle is freezing on the ground, as well as on vehicles and other objects. In the middle of the day Saturday and Sunday there may locally be less fog, the temperature may locally be above freezing point, and the danger may thus decrease temporarily.
alerts.instruction: Locally difficult driving conditions: Allow extra time for travel and driving. Use correct tires and drive according to the conditions. Follow the updates: Stay updated on weather warnings. Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk.

alerts.title: Heavy rain, yellow level, Parts of Troms and Nordland, 2026-11-08T03:00:00+00:00, 2026-11-09T11:00:00+00:00
alerts.description: A lot of rain is expected from Sunday morning to late Monday morning, locally around 40-50 mm during 24 hours. This is part of a longer rain event, from Saturday morning to late Monday morning, where it is expected locally 70-90 mm/48t.
alerts.instruction: Flooding may occur: Consider clearing drains and gutters so water can flow away. Difficult driving conditions: Check road conditions at vegvesen.no/trafikk. Adjust your speed and drive according to the conditions. Flooding and landslides: Check warnings at Varsom.no.
